skills.name: agent-skill-router
skills.description: Select a specialized repository workflow when an engineering request does not name a skill. Skip additional skills when ordinary coding judgment is sufficient.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-skill-router to choose the best skills for the current engineering task.

skills.name: agentic-engineering
skills.description: Build and review tool-using agents and durable agent workflows. Use for control flow, tool contracts, memory, recovery, budgets, and delegation decisions; not ordinary AI-assisted coding.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $agentic-engineering to design the smallest reliable tool-using workflow with explicit state, permissions, budgets, and recovery.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review code, API contracts, and tests for concrete bugs, compatibility failures, and false confidence. Use for diffs, PRs, proposed contracts, or dedicated test reviews.
skills.shortDescription: Review or grill changes for production risk
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $code-review to review or adversarially grill these changes and lead with findings.

skills.name: database-schema-design
skills.description: Design or review schema changes, constraints, indexes, data lifecycle, and migration rollout. Use when durable data shape or migration behavior changes, rather than for every database query.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $database-schema-design to design or review database tables and entities.

skills.name: decision-memory
skills.description: Search or record repository decisions with rationale, evidence, and supersession using the bundled local ledger. Use for explicit decision records or changes that revisit a prior decision.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $decision-memory to record or retrieve the relevant engineering decision.

skills.name: dribbble-design
skills.description: Develop frontend design directions from Dribbble references, screenshots, or existing UI. Use for visual inspiration, moodboards, hierarchy, typography, and design critiques; not mechanical frontend fixes.
skills.shortDescription: Turn visual inspiration into usable frontend design
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $dribbble-design to research visual references and recommend a distinctive, usable frontend direction for this screen.

skills.name: graph-engineering
skills.description: Design and review knowledge graphs, dependency graphs, and GraphRAG pipelines. Use for entity identity, provenance, temporal facts, traversal, or graph retrieval quality; not workflow orchestration.
skills.shortDescription: Design grounded graphs and graph retrieval
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $graph-engineering to design a grounded graph model and retrieval pipeline with provenance, freshness, and baseline evaluation.

skills.name: harness-engineering
skills.description: Design and improve coding-agent environments, feedback loops, and evaluation harnesses. Use for reproducibility, task verification, context handoffs, or measured agent reliability.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $harness-engineering to improve the agent environment and independently measure task completion against a fixed baseline.

skills.name: implementation-plan
skills.description: Plan changes with meaningful sequencing, migration, rollout, or validation dependencies. Use when a plan is requested or execution needs coordination; skip formal plans for straightforward edits.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $implementation-plan to inspect the project and create a practical implementation plan.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.description: Triage production degradation and assess mitigation, rollback, or hotfix options. Use during an active incident or when preparing its post-mortem.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $incident-response to triage this production incident.

skills.name: observability-design
skills.description: Design or audit service logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, dashboards, and alerts. Use for instrumentation changes, telemetry gaps, logging noise, or actionable paging.
skills.shortDescription: Design logs, metrics, traces, and alerts
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $observability-design to add appropriate structured logs and telemetry to this service.

skills.name: product-competitive-thinking
skills.description: Evaluate startup product bets, MVP scope, onboarding, pricing, or competitor-driven requests. Use when user value, differentiation, or learning needs a decision, rather than every UI edit.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $product-competitive-thinking to evaluate product decisions from PM and competitor viewpoints.

skills.name: repository-map
skills.description: Generate or refresh a repository file and symbol map using bundled scripts. Use for broad discovery in an unfamiliar or large repository; skip mapping when the relevant files are already known.
skills.shortDescription: Map repository files and symbols for broad discovery
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $repository-map to generate compact project context and a file map when broad discovery is needed; enrich only when useful.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Review changed trust boundaries for reachable security and privacy failures: auth, tenant isolation, secrets, uploads, webhooks, injection, and dependency trust.
skills.shortDescription: Find exploitable security and privacy risks
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $security-review to review this change for concrete security and privacy vulnerabilities.
